## Context

On macOS, `pytest -q tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py::test_windows_noop` reports `1 passed, 1 error`: the test body passes, then the autouse `_one_engine_root` teardown raises `NotImplementedError: cannot instantiate 'WindowsPath' on your system`. Reproduced at current `origin/main` in a fresh worktree.

## Root cause

`tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py:643` runs `monkeypatch.setattr(D.os, "name", "nt")`. `D.os` is the process-wide `os` module, so this rebinds `os.name` globally. `pathlib.Path.__new__` dispatches on the live `os.name`, so from that statement until `monkeypatch` undoes it, every `Path(...)` in the process yields `WindowsPath`, which refuses to instantiate on a POSIX host.

The undo does not happen before the guard runs. `pytest --setup-plan` on this test shows `monkeypatch` is set up FIRST of the function-scoped fixtures, because several autouse fixtures request it; teardown is LIFO, so `monkeypatch` is torn down LAST. `_one_engine_root` tears down well before it, while `os.name` is still `nt`.

The guard's hot path is `foreign_engine_registrations` -> `_module_offences` -> `_foreign_root(str(file_name))` -> `engine_root_of`, and `engine_root_of` at `tests/_engine_path.py:96` calls `Path(path).resolve()`. On a `_foreign_root` cache miss for a path not seen before, that is the construction that raises. The observed miss was `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/__init__.py`.

This is a class defect, not one test. The guard runs after every test in the suite, so any test that sets `os.name` breaks it. `tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py:641` already carries a workaround comment telling authors to resolve paths before mocking `os.name`, which is evidence the edge has bitten before.

## Fix

Make the guard's resolution string-based so it never depends on `os.name`. `os.path` and `os.sep` are bound at interpreter start and are unaffected by rebinding `os.name`, so `os.path.realpath` resolves identically while `Path` does not.

In `tests/_engine_path.py`: add a private `_engine_root_str(path)` that resolves with `os.path.realpath(os.fspath(path))`, splits on `os.sep`, scans for the adjacent `_ENGINE_MARKER` pair, and returns the joined root as a `str` or `None`. Reduce `engine_root_of` to wrapping it in `Path`, preserving its public signature. Change `_foreign_root` to return `str | None` from `_engine_root_str`, comparing against a new `lru_cache`d `_canonical_engine_root_str()` of `os.path.realpath(engine_dir())` instead of re-running `engine_dir().resolve()` on every miss. Change the two `str(Path(...).resolve())` expressions in `_module_offences` to `os.path.realpath(...)`, which yields the same string.

After this, the whole post-test guard path constructs no `Path`, so no part of it dispatches on `os.name`.

`_foreign_root` is private to `tests/_engine_path.py` and its only caller is `_module_offences`, which tests it with `is not None`, so the return-type change reaches nothing else. `engine_root_of`, `engine_dir` and `foreign_engine_registrations` keep their current signatures and values.

## Non-goals

The foreign-engine detection rule is unchanged: the same marker pair, the same canonical root, the same offender set. `tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py` is not modified; the fix belongs in the guard so it holds for every future test that sets `os.name`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py::test_windows_noop` reports `1 passed` with no error, where it currently reports `1 passed, 1 error`.
- [ ] `tests/_engine_path.py` defines `_engine_root_str` returning `str | None` and resolving via `os.path.realpath`.
- [ ] `engine_root_of` still accepts `str | Path` and still returns `Path | None`.
- [ ] `_foreign_root` returns `str | None` and calls `_engine_root_str`, not `engine_root_of`.
- [ ] `_foreign_root` compares against `_canonical_engine_root_str()` rather than calling `engine_dir().resolve()`.
- [ ] Neither `_module_offences` nor `_foreign_root` nor `_engine_root_str` constructs a `pathlib.Path`.
- [ ] A new test in `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` sets `os.name` to `nt` with `monkeypatch` and asserts `foreign_engine_registrations` returns without raising `NotImplementedError`.
- [ ] A new test in `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` sets `os.name` to `nt` with `monkeypatch` and asserts `engine_root_of` on a path outside any engine tree returns `None`.
- [ ] The existing `test_engine_root_of_ignores_paths_outside_any_engine_tree` passes unchanged, pinning that `engine_root_of` still returns `engine_dir()` for an engine file.
- [ ] The existing foreign-copy detection test in `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` that builds a `shutil.copytree` duplicate still reports that copy as an offender.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` exits 0.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.

## Testing

Reproduce first with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py::test_windows_noop` and confirm the `1 passed, 1 error` baseline. Confirm the teardown ordering with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -p no:randomly --setup-plan tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py::test_windows_noop`. After the change, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py`, then `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` before push.
